meta.name: Concept-Generate-Refine
meta.description: Creative content pipeline that develops concepts, generates initial content, then iteratively critiques and refines through cross-model review. Features creative direction tracking and diminishing returns detection.
meta.author: Hankweave Templates

hank.name: Concept: Develop the creative direction
hank.description: Explore the creative brief and establish the conceptual foundation, themes, and direction

hank.name: Generate: Create the initial content
hank.description: Produce the first complete version of the content based on the concept

codons.name: Critique: Cross-model creative assessment
codons.description: Independent critique from a different model for diverse perspective

codons.name: Refine: Incorporate critique feedback
codons.description: Apply critique feedback to improve the content

hank.name: Format: Final output formatting
hank.description: Apply final formatting, structure, and presentation to the refined content
